annotations.title: Tell the assistant on the live call

description: Send a message into a live call; the assistant says it within a couple of seconds. Use it to answer pending_question (pass its question_id; the business is waiting, about 45 seconds), or anytime to change course: "Make it 6 people instead of 4", "Also ask if they price-match", "Don't book, just get the price", "Wrap up and hang up". An answer from what's already known is fastest; the user is the fallback. A late answer is still passed along.

answer.description: The answer or instruction, e.g. "2019 Toyota RAV4" or "Yes, book 7:30"

question_id.description: pending_question_id from get_call (e.g. "q2"). Leave out to answer the newest question, or to steer when no question is waiting.
